o.text: Borrowed from Russian рома́н (román), ultimately from French roman.

Inherited from Proto-Turkic *(a)laču-k (“cottage, small yurt”), from Middle Chinese 廬舍 (“rudimentary lodgings”).
Cognate with Southern Altai аланчык (alančïk), Bashkir аласыҡ (alasıq), Chuvash лаҫӑ (laś̬ă), Kazakh лашық (lašıq), Kumyk алачыкъ (alaçıq), Kyrgyz алачык (alacık), Tatar алачык (alaçıq), Siberian Tatar алацық, Turkish alacık, Tuvan алажы (alajı), Chagatai الاچوق (alačuq), Uzbek olachiq, etc.
Borrowed from Russian че́рез (čérez). Unrelated to Turkish çerez below.
